notes.summary: Average = Sum ÷ Count. Almost every average question is solved by thinking in terms of the total. 1–2 questions per tier.

concepts.title: Work with totals
concepts.body: Total = Average × Number. When someone joins, leaves or is replaced, find the change in total.

concepts.title: Consecutive numbers
concepts.body: For numbers in AP (consecutive, consecutive odd/even), the average is the middle term = (first + last)/2. Average of first n natural numbers = (n + 1)/2.

concepts.title: Replacement shortcut
concepts.body: If one person is replaced and the average of n people rises by d, then New − Old = n × d.

varieties.name: Sum and average
varieties.how: Convert averages to totals and subtract.

example.q: Average of 4 numbers is 20. One more number makes the average 22. Find it.

varieties.name: Joining, leaving, replacement
varieties.how: New person = old average + (new count × change) or use New − Old = n × d.

example.q: Average weight of 10 boys rises by 2 kg when a 50 kg boy is replaced. New boy’s weight?

varieties.name: Consecutive numbers and innings
varieties.how: Use the middle term for AP sets; for cricket, set the old average as x.

example.q: Average of 5 consecutive even numbers is 16. Largest?

tips: Always convert average to total first.
For a new member raising average by d: new member = old average + (new count) × d.
traps: When the teacher is included, the count becomes n + 1.
Average speed is not always the simple average of speeds.

formulas.name: Replacement
formulas.expr: New − Old = n × change in average

questions.q: What is the average of the first 10 natural numbers?
The average of 5 numbers is 27. If one number is excluded, the average of the remaining numbers becomes 25. What is the excluded number?
questions.solution:
Total of 5 numbers = 5 × 27 = 135.
Total of 4 numbers = 4 × 25 = 100.
Excluded number = 135 − 100 = 35.

questions.q: The average age of 30 students in a class is 15 years. When the teacher’s age is included, the average becomes 16 years. What is the teacher’s age?
questions.solution:
Total for students = 30 × 15 = 450.
Total with teacher = 31 × 16 = 496.
Teacher’s age = 496 − 450 = 46 years.

questions.q: The average of 7 consecutive odd numbers is 33. What is the largest of these numbers?
A batsman scores 87 runs in his 17th innings and thereby increases his average by 3. What is his average after the 17th innings?
questions.solution:
Let the average after 16 innings be x.
16x + 87 = 17(x + 3) → x = 87 − 51 = 36.
New average = 36 + 3 = 39.

questions.q: The average weight of 8 persons increases by 2.5 kg when a new person comes in place of one of them weighing 65 kg. What is the weight of the new person?
questions.solution:
Increase in total = 8 × 2.5 = 20 kg.
New person = 65 + 20 = 85 kg.
